description: A native German woman in her late fifties. She speaks clear standard German as her mother tongue, with no English or American accent. Firm, direct and a little indignant - the voice of someone correcting a stranger because somebody has to. Middle register, crisp consonants, unhurried. Polite even while telling you off. Not shrill, not angry, not theatrical: the everyday authority of a neighbour, not a drill sergeant.
texte: Bei Rot bleibt man stehen! Denken Sie an die Kinder! Die schauen doch zu. Hier wartet man, auch wenn kein Auto kommt. So macht man das bei uns.
